part.text:
Implemented tuple `fmt::join` format-specifier support in `include/fmt/ranges.h`.

The tuple join formatter now:
- Keeps one formatter instance per tuple element.
- Parses the supplied format specifier into every element formatter.
- Uses those parsed formatter instances when rendering each tuple value.

This makes calls such as `fmt::format("{:02}", fmt::join(tuple, ", "))` apply `:02` to every compatible tuple element, consistently with range joins.

Validation passed:
```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-fmtlib__fmt-2457-12226f33 sh -lc 'cd /testbed && cmake --build build --target ranges-test -j2 && ./build/bin/ranges-test'
```

All 19 `ranges-test` tests passed. `git diff --check` also passed.
